description: Manual cases for a story with bounded fields (username 4-20, name 2-50), an undefined message (duplicate email), an ambiguous rule (secure password) and a contradiction (age 16 / 18).
prompt: Use the manual-case-generator agent to generate the test cases for the story input/stories/US-901-signup.md. There are no active connectors: the Jira comments are copied into the story itself.

checks.description: The spreadsheet has the template columns
At least 10 cases with consecutive IDs TC-001…, priorities and statuses from the scale, sorted by priority, with steps and result
Coverage by type: positive, negative and boundary

negative.pattern: invalid|incorrect|empty|blank|reject|not (be )?allowed|is not created|without |already (registered|exists|in use)|duplicat|under(age)?\b|minor|younger|outside|out of range|weak|does not (meet|comply)|@negativ

checks.description: Applies boundary values to the username (3/4 and 20/21 characters)
Flags the cases that depend on missing information and builds the Missing information sheet
The duplicate email case depends on an MI and does not invent the message text
The minimum age cases are flagged as Missing information (they do not choose between 16 and 18)
Uses the exact text that the story does define (AC5)
patterns: Username must be between 4 and 20 characters

checks.description: The coverage report goes through the five criteria and the Missing information
Runs the coverage report tables through format_tables.py

rubric: The steps are actionable and the expected result is verifiable.
There are no redundant cases (two cases that test exactly the same thing).
The assumptions used to write a case are explained in Comments.
